domains.objective: Create explicit branch or work quanta without duplicating identity, authority, or hidden scheduler state.
Remove only superseded unreferenced alternatives with evidence that no live dependency is destroyed.
Count active alternatives, workers, mutations, and authority instances as first-class observables.
Detect when ordering two operations changes observable state and therefore requires fencing or serialization.
Represent variable populations of branch/work quanta while conserving Cell lineage and epoch identity.
Compare fixed-population strategy alternatives under deterministic energy, risk, cost, and evidence weights.
Allow branch population to expand or contract under explicit capacity and priority chemical potentials.
Replay bounded work under fixed evidence and resource constraints to isolate deterministic divergence.
Normalize competing strategy weights without treating probabilistic ranking as release authority.
Balance expected value, risk, cost, and entropy when ranking alternatives for later human or policy selection.
Measure useful exploration entropy separately from duplication, stale-state, and coordination debt.
Translate priority and scarce-capacity pressure into bounded admission without starvation or hidden preemption.
Define measurable order parameters for scheduler, Cell, publication, policy, and promotion authority singularity.
Make the transition from equivalent competing implementations to one selected authority explicit and reversible before release.
Detect accidental winner-take-all branch dominance before evidence justifies selection.
Detect sharp changes in retry, queue, conflict, cost, or latency response before the system crosses an unstable phase boundary.
Measure sensitivity of factory behavior to small pressure, policy, provider, or concurrency perturbations.
Measure how far one failure, retry storm, policy change, or event burst propagates across Cells and repositories.
Coarse-grain local worker details into stable higher-level contracts without erasing safety-critical evidence.
Identify invariants that remain valid across providers, languages, repositories, and workload scales.
Detect when local dependency connectivity becomes a system-wide failure or scheduling cluster.
Represent many locally plausible but globally incompatible implementations without pretending a single optimum exists.
Detect constraint sets that cannot all be satisfied simultaneously and require explicit tradeoff or rejection.
Keep apparently stable but weakly evidenced branches from silently becoming release defaults.
Require sufficient evidence before a local experimental pattern seeds broader architectural adoption.
Track durable discontinuities in lineage, policy, schema, or ownership that cannot be repaired by local retries alone.
Make trust, tenant, provider, repository, and policy boundaries explicit where state or authority may not freely cross.
Model bounded inner work as a dependency lattice while Airflow remains the sole lifecycle scheduler.
Sample diverse implementation strategies under bounded budgets while preserving deterministic evidence and replay metadata.
Ensure forward retry and rollback/repair transitions do not accumulate hidden irreversible mutation bias.
Measure the response of queues, Cells, providers, and evidence lag to localized perturbations.
Relate observed operational fluctuations to the controls required to damp them without over-throttling useful work.
Provide a stable aggregate capacity approximation while retaining local overload and fairness constraints.
Allow compatible work to share warm resources and execution locality without merging identity or evidence.
Enforce exclusive occupancy where simultaneous ownership, mutation, or publication would violate correctness.
Define the empty stable state after all temporary workers, stale branches, orphan mutations, and superseded abstractions have dissipated.

concerns.name: operator law
concerns.slice: Define identities, algebra, ordering, units, and the machine-checkable invariant.

concerns.name: durable state
concerns.slice: Persist populations, order parameters, and phase state crash-safely with migration semantics.

concerns.name: versioned observable
concerns.slice: Expose deterministic operator and ensemble observables through a versioned backend contract.

concerns.name: Airflow coupling
concerns.slice: Integrate only as advisory input to Airflow-owned lifecycle scheduling and mapped task execution.

concerns.name: operator console
concerns.slice: Expose counts, probabilities, conflicts, criticality, and repair boundaries in CLI/TUI views.

concerns.name: security algebra
concerns.slice: Preserve least privilege, tenant isolation, epoch fencing, and fail-closed authority boundaries.

concerns.name: failure statistics
concerns.slice: Specify retry, cancellation, timeout, ambiguity, stale-writer, and restart distributions and cutoffs.

concerns.name: thermodynamic scale
concerns.slice: Bound population, entropy, pressure, correlation, and computational cost under sustained stress.

concerns.name: evidence ensemble
concerns.slice: Retain signals, weights, decisions, refusals, latency, cost, and causal response evidence.

concerns.name: noncrystalline convergence
concerns.slice: Prepare entropy collapse and authority selection while explicitly refusing final crystallization.
